headline_seed: People's houses are collapsing into the ocean. FEMA gives them no other option - NPR
draft_text:
NPR reports more than 30 homes have collapsed into the ocean in Dare County, NC since 2020, with roughly 100 more at risk.

NPR says FEMA flood insurance pays out after collapse but not before, leaving owners no financial choice.

reported by NPR, not yet confirmed elsewhere.
